name: proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 5

function.text: PCSK5 is the approved symbol for proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in endopeptidase activity; endopeptidase inhibitor activity; anterior/posterior pattern specification.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Hepatocellular carcinoma; Cutaneous melanoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: PCSK5 encodes proprotein convertase subtilisin/kexin type 5. Its functions include endopeptidase activity and endopeptidase inhibitor activity.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving PCSK5 have been reported in cutaneous melanoma and hepatocellular carcinoma.
